newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa's Afribrand says in talks.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa's Afribrand says in talks.

text.p: South Africa's Afribrand Ltd, which only listed a day ago, on Wednesday moved quickly into action and said that it was in talks that could have an effect on its share price.
The firm warned shareholders to exercise caution when dealing in its stock until a further announcement is made.
The firm gave no other details in a brief statement.
Afribrand listed on Tuesday and soared to a 226 close from its 100 cents issue price.
The firm specialises in marketing and distributing branded products into lower economic markets and particularly hawker shop sectors.
One reason for the stock's warm reception by the market was its almost unique exposure to South Africa's emerging street-level markets.
The company's private placing of shares was 75 times oversubscribed, one of the highest over-subscriptions for a share offer in South African investment history.
